指出群体信念风险及集成挑战，强调运行时显式约束信念修正对实现可扩展智能体安全至关重要。

title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM智能体中的信任区域效应：注入位置的影响
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions of their environments. For example, an agent powered by GPT-5.4 follows an unsafe injection instruction placed in a repository documentation file (i.e., a README or TODO file) 2.6 times more often on average than the same instruction placed in a code or data file. Building upon this observation, we develop learning-based attackers that generate injection content and select better injection placements. Our approach demonstrates that both where an injection is placed and what content it contains can affect the strength of indirect prompt injection attacks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic characterization for the effectiveness of different injection placements, spanning both coarse-grained environmental surfaces and fine-grained positions. The uneven trust that agents implicitly place across their environments provides important insights for future attack and defense design.
summary_zh: 现有LLM智能体风险评估多关注间接提示注入内容，缺乏对注入位置影响的系统刻画。
构建跨工具、编程和日常工作的智能体测试床，固定注入内容，发现智能体易感性随注入位置变化。
揭示智能体对不同环境区域隐式赋予不同信任的信任区域效应，并基于此开发学习型攻击者，验证位置与内容均影响攻击强度。

title: Learning to Reason from Reference Samples Alone: Reinforced Adversarial Learning for Modern LLM Post-Training
title_zh: 仅从参考样本学习推理：现代LLM后训练的强化对抗学习
abstract: In many settings where LLM post-training is desirable, high-quality answers are recognizable but difficult to score with explicit rewards. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited to tasks where an explicit correctness signal is available. Prior adversarial approaches to training reasoning LLMs either complement verifiable rewards with co-trained critics or require reference reasoning traces. We ask whether a co-trained LLM judge can turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training of reasoning LLMs. We call this method Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL). We first validate RAL on three verifiable tasks (integer multiplication, code-based arithmetic-expression synthesis, and SMILES-to-formula translation), using the verifiers only for evaluation. With sufficiently capable judges and enough training, RAL matches direct RLVR. We then apply RAL to scientific abstract generation in two settings. In the first setting, RAL guides the generator to produce abstracts in the scientific domain of the reference abstracts, even though the prompt leaves that domain unspecified. In the second setting, we generate abstracts for U.S. National Institutes of Health grant proposals conditioned on the grant title. Human scientists and an ensemble of LLM judges find our generations harder to distinguish from real abstracts than those of frontier-LLM baselines. These results suggest a path toward post-training reasoning models in scientific and other high-value domains, where increasingly capable judges infer hard-to-specify reward functions from example answers.
summary_zh: 现有RLVR依赖显式奖励，且先前对抗方法需协同训练评判器或参考推理轨迹，限制了LLM后训练应用。
提出强化对抗学习方法RAL，仅利用参考答案，通过协同训练的LLM评判器作为策略训练的唯一奖励。
RAL在可验证任务上媲美RLVR，在科学摘要生成上超越前沿基线，为高价值领域后训练提供新路径。
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices

title: SuperCrude EoS: A Simple, Analytical, and Reasonably Accurate Equation of State for Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics
title_zh: SuperCrude：一种用于天体物理流体力学的简单解析状态方程
abstract: We present SuperCrude, a vastly simplified astrophysical equation of state that captures the most important physics needed for explosive astrophysics, but using compact, physically-motivated analytical approximations rather than precise interpolated data tables. We present a number of code tests demonstrating the performance of SuperCrude in a wide range of parameter space. In large regions of parameter space, SuperCrude is precisely accurate to within the accuracy level of helmeos. For some regions (especially where degeneracy, gas, and radiation are comparable) SuperCrude has errors in its effective adiabatic index on the order of a few percent. The solver's estimate of the temperature is less accurate, on the order of tens of percent. Because the solver is analytic, SuperCrude is designed in such a way to guarantee exact thermodynamic consistency. We incorporate SuperCrude into some hydrodynamic and astrophysical test problems, including the thermonuclear explosion of a white dwarf star. When coupled with a stiff nuclear network, SuperCrude does not achieve the same nucleosynthetic yields as helmeos, motivating future work to improve the temperature accuracy further.
summary_zh: 传统天体物理状态方程依赖复杂数据表，提出SuperCrude采用紧凑的解析近似来捕捉爆炸天体物理的关键物理过程。
在大部分参数空间内其精度与helmeos相当，仅在简并、气体和辐射可比区域有百分之几误差，且解析形式保证了精确的热力学一致性。
将其耦合硬核网络进行白矮星热核爆炸测试，因温度估计误差较大导致核合成产率不同，未来需进一步提升温度精度。

title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
title_zh: CopyLoop：基于上下文复制与浅层筛选的循环Transformer快速解码
abstract: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.
summary_zh: 循环Transformer因循环深度导致全深度解码开销大，且现有推测解码受限于串行开销。
提出免训练解码算法CopyLoop，利用低成本上下文复制提议与浅层筛选及连续循环调度，实现多token并发验证。
在代码生成与数学推理任务上，CopyLoop相对全深度自回归解码最高提速10.70倍，且随生成长度增加优势更明显。

title: When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents
title_zh: 运行时感知上下文：解决AI编程Agent的相关代码失效问题
abstract: AI coding agents increasingly rely on retrieved code and development history to guide software changes. However, highly relevant artifacts may describe implementations that are inactive or incompatible with the target deployment. Neither semantic similarity nor recency establishes whether retrieved information remains applicable under feature flags, architectural migrations, and deployment-specific configurations. We challenge relevance-oriented retrieval by introducing operational context validity, a task-, deployment-, and time-dependent criterion for determining whether software evidence can legitimately guide implementation decisions. We instantiate this new retrieval principle in CASE, an agent-agnostic framework that connects repository artifacts with runtime configurations and architectural evolution, classifies evidence as valid, invalid, or unknown, and generates context packages distinguishing actionable guidance from historical rationale and unresolved constraints. We investigate its feasibility through a reproducible preliminary evaluation involving six development tasks, 15 artifacts, and three deployments. Conventional retrieval exposes 16 incompatible artifact occurrences as actionable, whereas CASE excludes them while retaining all applicable artifacts under the prototype's reference rules. Recency filtering reduces valid recall to 0.43, while removing feature-flag evidence from CASE reduces it to 0.13. Although these results demonstrate feasibility rather than improvements in coding-agent correctness, they reveal limitations of relevance-based retrieval and motivate a new research direction: enabling coding agents to reason not only about which information is relevant, but also whether it remains operationally valid.
summary_zh: AI编程Agent依赖检索代码辅助开发，但高相关度代码可能因特性开关或架构迁移而在目标部署中失效，传统语义相似度和时间过滤无法解决此问题。
提出操作上下文有效性准则，并构建CASE框架，将代码与运行时配置及架构演进关联，将证据分类为有效、无效或未知，生成区分可操作指导与历史依据的上下文包。
初步评估表明，传统检索将不兼容证据误判为可操作，而CASE能排除它们并保留所有适用证据；基于时间的过滤和移除特性开关证据均严重降低有效召回率，验证了该框架的可行性。

title: CARI: Cross-Boundary Adversarial Runtime Injection in Coding-Agent Workflows
title_zh: 编码代理工作流中的跨边界对抗性运行时注入
abstract: Coding agents increasingly develop, test, and integrate software whose components are owned by different developers, teams, or services. This exposes a distinct attack surface: a malicious or compromised peer development role can manipulate a live component of the software under development (e.g., a backend service, test harness, CI job, or deployment service) and influence the runtime feedback that another role's coding agent must process to complete its task. Although such a component has legitimate diagnostic authority to report its own state, it has no action authority over the victim's local files, credentials, shell, or development environment. We introduce Cross-Boundary Adversarial Runtime Injection (CARI), a direct runtime-feedback injection setting that exploits this authority mismatch. Rather than explicitly compromising the victim's prompt, model, tools, or local environment, the attacker covertly embeds malicious instructions in task-relevant runtime feedback produced by a peer-controlled development component. The victim then interprets that feedback as part of normal debugging or recovery, and may translate the diagnostic guidance into unauthorized victim-side actions. We instantiate ten different attacks based on CARI, spanning resource exhaustion, information exposure, and development-state manipulation. Across four programming languages and five code-capable models, CARI succeeds in 2,845/3,000 (94.8%) trials. Furthermore, CARI transfers effectively to product-level coding agents, achieving 61.3% attack success on Codex and 58.7% on Claude Code. By contrast, prompt-level defenses exhibit a security-utility trade-off: generic warnings are ineffective, whereas explicit policies suppress attacks but substantially over-refuse legitimate actions.
summary_zh: 多角色协作开发中，恶意对等组件可操纵运行时反馈，影响受害编码代理的任务执行。
提出CARI攻击方法，利用诊断与操作权限不匹配，将恶意指令隐蔽嵌入运行时反馈中，诱使代理执行未授权操作。
实验表明CARI攻击成功率高达94.8%，且可迁移至产品级代理；而提示级防御存在安全与效用的权衡困境。

title: Leaving, Staying, or Living There? Duration Commonsense Reasoning with Human-LLM Co-annotations
title_zh: 人类与大模型协同标注的时长常识推理
abstract: Gardening in the backyard implies living there, while checking into an Airbnb more likely means staying for a few days. Such duration judgments are important for understanding human mobility, travel behavior, and social context. However, duration is rarely stated explicitly in social media posts and must instead be inferred from noisy textual, visual, and contextual cues. In this paper, we investigate whether vision-language models possess such duration commonsense. We create a new corpus of geotagged tweets co-annotated by humans and LLMs to serve as a testbed for this task. We find that state-of-the-art models struggle with duration inference, even when guided by multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting. Error analyses further reveal that models often fail to integrate critical contextual information, or they overly rely on prominent visual details while overlooking subtle hashtags and semantic nuances. These findings underscore the significant challenges remaining in context-aware multimodal understanding.
summary_zh: 社交媒体中活动时长常隐含未提，需从文本、视觉和上下文线索推断，现有模型缺乏此时长常识。
构建人类与LLM协同标注的带地理标签推文语料库，作为评估视觉语言模型时长推理能力的测试集。
实验表明先进模型在多轮CoT引导下仍推理困难，常忽略关键上下文或过度依赖视觉细节，凸显多模态理解挑战。

title: The Birthday Problem and the Birthday Person Problem: Intuition, Probability and Cryptographic Applications
title_zh: 生日问题与生日人问题：直觉、概率及密码学应用
abstract: The present work discusses the birthday problem and the birthday person problem, two classical problems in probability theory widely used to illustrate situations in which human intuition diverges from mathematical results. Taking the work of [1] as its main reference, the study analyzes the probability of birthday coincidences within groups of people, considering a year with 365 days and assuming that all birth dates are equally likely. The birthday problem seeks to determine the probability that at least two people in a group share the same birthday, showing that, even in relatively small groups, the probability of a coincidence increases rapidly due to the large number of possible pairwise comparisons among individuals. In contrast, the birthday person problem investigates the probability that a previously selected person shares the same birthday as another member of the group. This probability increases more slowly, since the number of relevant comparisons is restricted to the pairs formed by the selected person and the remaining members of the group. Despite the interpretative differences, both problems share a similar mathematical foundation based on combinatorial analysis and probability theory. In addition to the theoretical development, numerical results and graphical representations are presented to illustrate the behavior of the probabilities involved and to visualize how the likelihood of coincidences increases as the number of people grows. Finally, applications related to computing and cryptography are discussed, particularly the study of collisions in hash functions and the so-called birthday attack. The discussion highlights the importance of probabilistic reasoning in understanding apparently unlikely phenomena, while also emphasizing how the growth in the number of possible combinations directly influences the results obtained.
summary_zh: 人类直觉常与概率结果相悖，需重新审视生日巧合等经典概率问题的数学基础。
对比生日问题与生日人问题：前者因配对多概率增速快，后者仅限指定人配对故增速慢。
将理论应用于密码学中的哈希碰撞与生日攻击，凸显概率推理对理解罕见现象的价值。

title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
title_zh: AtomTree：基于LLM的状态感知具身指令跟随层次框架
abstract: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/.
summary_zh: 现有具身规划方法依赖语言常识且仅在失败后更新，鲁棒性与状态感知弱。
提出AtomTree框架，增量构建子目标树，由LLM依当前状态决定分解或执行底层动作。
引入轻量记忆模块复用历史，动作受阻时触发层次回溯重规划，ALFRED上优于已有LLM规划器。

title: RuleForge: Inferring and Instantiating Latent Visual Rules as Executable Programs
title_zh: RuleForge：推断潜在视觉规则并实例化为可执行程序
abstract: Visual rule reasoning asks whether multimodal models can recover an abstract concept from a few examples. Existing studies either infer rules from visual examples but evaluate only classification or verbalization, or supervise executable generation with rules provided as input. Consequently, the relationship between visual rule understanding and reliable rule instantiation remains insufficiently explored. We present Bongard-Forge100k, a controlled benchmark, together with RuleForge, a backbone-agnostic framework that jointly learns visual rule understanding and rule-conditioned executable generation. The benchmark contains 108,797 problems: 86,000 for training, 19,297 for testing familiar rules, and 3,500 for testing held-out rule compositions. The framework progresses through rule-understanding training, joint understanding and scene-program supervision, and refinement via execution-grounded reinforcement learning with Understanding Replay. Executing generated programs under multiple random seeds provides verifiable feedback on executability, rule satisfaction, diversity, and robustness. With UniLIP as the primary backbone, RuleForge improves multiple-choice accuracy over the base model by 20.93 percentage points on familiar rules and 28.42 percentage points on held-out rule compositions, while increasing scene-level rule satisfaction on familiar rules from 2.91% to 70.99%. Additional experiments on InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL, and Show-o2 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed training data and framework across diverse multimodal architectures.
summary_zh: 现有视觉规则推理研究未充分探索规则理解与可靠实例化的关系，缺乏联合评估。
提出Bongard-Forge100k基准与RuleForge框架，联合学习视觉规则理解与规则条件下的可执行程序生成。
通过执行反馈的强化学习优化，RuleForge在熟悉规则上准确率提升20.93%，规则满足率从2.91%升至70.99%。

title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
title_zh: 临床指南推理的隐式决策流奖励方法
abstract: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.
summary_zh: 临床推理存在路径-答案差距与路径多重性，现有方法无法同时兼顾答案正确性与指南一致性。
提出GUIDER方法，联合优化决策流控制器与推理策略，通过多流过程奖励与答案门控解决上述问题。
在MedGUIDE等基准上，GUIDER显著提升指南遵循度与答案准确率，优于现有临床强化学习基线。

title: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
title_zh: 超越捏造：AI研究代理论文中的数字错配问题
abstract: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open research problems) and manually label 256 numerical claims from 18 submissions. Failures concentrate on alignment between the paper and the underlying work rather than overt cheating, and about four in five unsupported claims correspond to values in the agent's own files that come from the wrong experiment, metric, or run. We introduce a deterministic claim-to-evidence checker that scores whether the surrounding context identifies the claimed result and calibrates each claim against numerical decoys. With its rules fixed before labeling, it certifies claims with over 90% precision against blinded annotators (78 of 85; Cohen's kappa = 0.89), while verifying only a subset of claims; most claims it cannot verify are nevertheless traceable, so failure to verify is not evidence of falsehood. An LLM verifier given the same evidence recovers more traceable claims but accepts about three times as many misattributed ones, so the two are best used together. Applied to 99 submissions, the checker reveals large differences in traceability across agents, and a second judge from a different vendor preserves the official agent ranking while passing twice as many papers. These findings motivate provenance-first auditing of AI-produced research.
summary_zh: 现有AI论文完整性检查无法解释失败性质，且仅测内部一致性或数值是否存在，未解决数值错配问题。
本文重新分析540个公开评测判定并手动标注256个数值声明，发现多数失败源于论文与底层工作错配而非作弊。
提出确定性声明-证据检查器，认证声明准确率超90%，结合LLM验证器可互补，揭示代理间可追溯性差异巨大。
comment: 42 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/mos3b-faqeeh/agent-integrity-analysis

title: Deogen: Automatic Benchmark Generation for Reasoning over Policies
title_zh: Deogen：面向策略推理的自动基准生成器
abstract: Language models are increasingly being deployed in regulated settings, where a model must apply given rules to the facts of a situation to determine a verdict. Benchmarking this capability, known as deontic reasoning, remains a costly and manual process, with existing datasets largely hand-crafted. In this paper, we present DeoGen, a scalable, automatic, and parametrizable benchmark generator for deontic reasoning. By autoformalizing policy rules to first-order logic, we can construct decision trees that capture possible outcome trajectories. Each path down a tree becomes a benchmark entry, with each tree producing combinatorially many entries relative to tree depth. Paths ending at a leaf entail a verdict, while non-leaf paths measure a model's ability to abstain when presented with insufficient information. Evaluations show frontier models return the correct verdict 89-92% of the time. Notably, performance degrades (22-40% correct) on entries without sufficient information to claim a verdict, even with explicit instructions to abstain in such cases. In all, DeoGen presents an automatic, scalable, and parametric method for generating deontic reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有道义推理基准依赖人工构建，成本高且难以规模化，无法满足LLM在受监管场景下的评测需求。
提出DeoGen生成器，将策略规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑并构建决策树，利用树路径组合生成大量测试条目。
前沿模型在信息充足时准确率达89-92%，但在信息不足需弃权时准确率骤降至22-40%，揭示了模型缺陷。

title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
title_zh: 弱化诱导的同策略自蒸馏：提升大型推理模型
abstract: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privileged information. We explore two ways to construct the weaker model: low-bit quantization and magnitude pruning. We evaluate WISD across diverse architectures and scales on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks. Across these benchmarks, quantization and pruning improve average accuracy over the original models by 4.0 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance even without privileged information. Notably, pruning raises Qwen3.5-4B's accuracy from 57.7% to 70.5% on HMMT 2025 and from 39.1% to 56.7% on LiveCodeBench v6. Quantization raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's accuracy from 68.5% to 74.6% and from 61.8% to 69.5% on the same benchmarks, respectively. These results establish WISD as a novel and effective self-distillation framework for large reasoning models.
summary_zh: 无外部教师时，传统自蒸馏依赖特权信息构建强教师，限制了仅含无标签提示时的应用。
提出弱化诱导同策略自蒸馏WISD，通过低比特量化或幅值剪枝构建弱模型，以两者差异作为训练信号。
WISD无需特权信息，在数学与编程推理任务上平均准确率最高提升5.5个百分点，达到SOTA水平。
comment: Work in progress. Code is released at https://github.com/jet-ai-projects/WISD

title: Differentiable Schwarz-Coupled Solvers for Thin Boundary Layer Transport: Inverse Modeling via Agentic AI Optimization
title_zh: 基于可微Schwarz耦合求解器与Agentic AI的薄边界层逆建模
abstract: High-Péclet-number transport problems give rise to thin boundary layers with steep near-wall gradients whose accurate solution requires high-resolution meshes and could challenge inverse modeling. To address this challenge, we develop an overlapping Schwarz domain-decomposition framework grounded in perturbation theory, in which an inner equation governs near-wall dynamics and an outer equation governs bulk transport, and both subproblems are discretized using the finite element method and assembled into a fully differentiable multidomain physics solver. The formulation permits coarser mesh resolutions, reducing computational cost relative to a single-domain formulation. Exploiting the differentiability of the coupled solver, we formulate inverse problems in which the governing equations and boundary conditions are imposed as hard constraints, with the Schwarz coupling enforcing interface continuity. To accelerate the resulting adjoint-based optimization, we integrate large language models (LLMs) into the inverse workflow in two distinct configurations: a standalone optimizer that proposes successive parameter updates from the adjoint-computed sensitivities and an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) approach with access to the complete solver workflow, enabling it to perform multistage optimization procedures. The agentic AI configuration is shown to be most advantageous when the spatially varying unknown is represented in a functional basis rather than a high-dimensional nodal field representation. In this case, the AI agent grows the library of candidate basis functions during optimization under a prescribed admission policy, admitting predefined families in stages and initializing their parameters. In short, our proposed framework integrates Schwarz-coupled differentiable physics with agentic AI optimization for the inverse modeling of multiscale transport problems.
summary_zh: 高Péclet数输运产生薄边界层，其高分辨率网格需求导致逆建模困难。
提出基于扰动理论的Schwarz区域分解框架，构建内外子域耦合的完全可微求解器，允许粗网格以降低计算成本。
将LLM集成于伴随优化流程，其中Agentic AI能多阶段优化并动态扩充基函数库，显著提升逆建模效率。

title: "Close enough?" An investigation into multiplication errors in LLMs
title_zh: LLM乘法错误机制探究：“足够接近”吗？
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently fail at multi-digit arithmetic, but the underlying mechanisms governing these failures remain poorly understood. While recent work demonstrates that addition errors follow a "noisy quantisation" model localised around carry boundaries, whether this framework generalises to multiplication remains an open question. In this work, we evaluate multiplication capabilities across several small base LLMs on a dataset of 16,991 problems spanning varied operand lengths. We show that multiplication errors do not conform to the addition-style noisy quantisation model. Instead, we uncover a novel error regime in small Qwen models: errors in lower-order columns predominantly preserve parity. Conversely, higher-order digit errors shift toward off-by-one carry failures. Our findings suggest that arithmetic computation in LLMs relies on distinct, multi-periodic internal representations where parity is tracked more robustly than exact digit identity, providing new mechanistic insights into numerical reasoning in transformers.
summary_zh: LLM多位数算术常出错，加法错误符合进位边界噪声量化模型，但该框架是否适用于乘法未知。
在16991个乘法问题上评估多个小型LLM，发现乘法错误不符合加法式噪声量化模型。
小模型低位错误多保持奇偶性，高位错误多为进位偏差；表明LLM算术依赖多周期内部表征。

title: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents
title_zh: 三思而后行：LLM Agent的决策门控机制
abstract: LLM agents increasingly perform consequential actions through external tools, yet their proposed actions are often executed without independent verification of policy compliance or task completion. We introduce JevAct, a runtime verification framework that intercepts selected agent actions before execution and enables feedback-driven correction. JevAct compiles domain policies into executable state checks and structured questions evaluated by a prefill-only decision model, which produces probability-based judgments without relying on LLM generation. By combining deterministic verification of tool-state facts with probabilistic assessment of conversational context, the framework identifies potentially invalid actions and premature task termination, providing targeted feedback for bounded revision. JevAct operates independently of the underlying agent model and requires no modifications to its parameters or tools. We evaluate JevAct across eleven LLM agents on $τ^2$-bench Airline and Telecom tasks and BFCL. Results show improvements in agent reliability across multiple models and benchmarks, with particularly consistent gains on Telecom and BFCL, while performance on Airline is more mixed. Overall, these findings suggest that combining structured decision models with executable verification can improve the reliability of tool-using LLM agents.
summary_zh: LLM Agent执行外部工具时缺乏对策略合规与任务完成的独立验证，易产生无效操作。
提出JevAct运行时验证框架，拦截动作并利用预填充决策模型结合确定性状态检查与概率性上下文评估进行纠正。
实验表明该框架无需修改Agent参数即可提升多模型可靠性，在Telecom和BFCL上增益显著。

title: How Deterministic SAST and AI Security Agents Divide the Work: Coverage, Harness Policy and Cost in Snyk VulnBench 2.0
title_zh: 确定性SAST与AI安全Agent的分工：覆盖、策略与成本
abstract: We ask what AI coding agents and AI security harnesses find that deterministic static application security testing (SAST) does not, and what they miss that SAST catches. VulnBench 2.0 is a benchmark of 108 hand-curated, attacker-reachable vulnerabilities in 20 open-source web applications in Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Java; 62 flow across more than one file. A finding is credited only if it locates the vulnerability's attacker-controlled source and its dangerous sink, each within two lines. We evaluate nine productized configurations under one blind protocol: the Snyk Code static analyzer, Claude Code's /security-review with three model and effort settings (one with the Snyk MCP server), Codex Security with GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra and Sol, and the DeepSec scanner with two model backends. Snyk Code reached 82.4% macro recall (89 of 108) and Claude Code with Opus 5 at xhigh effort 79.3% (85 of 108); they disagree on 28 vulnerabilities, split 16 to 12, too few to tell them apart. Neither engine was sufficient alone: together they reached 101 of 108, the ceiling of all seven comparable configurations combined, and the AI configurations also reported at least seven real vulnerabilities that the reference set did not contain and Snyk Code did not report. What an AI engine misses depends on its harness as much as on its model: without Claude Code's built-in review policy, the same model matched 16 instead of 9 of the 20 vulnerabilities in the classes that policy excludes or restricts (supplementary run on 19 of 20 applications); Codex Security with GPT-5.6 Sol located 80 vulnerabilities at file level but 34 at line level; DeepSec's model-free file selection kept a file from only 56 of the 108 flows. Coverage and cost were only loosely related. The harness, fixtures, reference sets and all run data are public.
summary_zh: 现有SAST与AI安全引擎在漏洞检测上各有遗漏，需明确二者能力边界与互补性。
基于VulnBench 2.0基准对Snyk Code及多种AI安全配置进行盲测，严格评估其定位漏洞源与汇的准确率。
SAST与AI互补性极强，二者结合可达最高覆盖率；AI检测效果高度依赖其harness策略而非仅靠模型，且覆盖率与成本松散相关。
comment: 44 pages, 21 figures, 7 tables. Benchmark harness, reference sets and all run data: https://github.com/snyk-labs/snyk-vulnbench ; companion site: https://vulnbench.com

title: Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM智能体修复选择中的评估-执行失配问题
abstract: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.
summary_zh: LLM智能体失败时，现有修复方法常借助外部评估器（如强模型或环境神谕）选择修复动作，但未考虑评估器与实际执行智能体的偏好差异。
本文固定失败轨迹与候选修复，以部署智能体的独立推演衡量真实收益，量化评估器选择造成的部署价值损失。
实验表明评估器与执行者失配会导致显著收益损失甚至偏好相反；修复应使用实际执行智能体验证，并标注其执行者。

title: Session-Bound Behavioral Watermarking for Autonomous LLM Agents
title_zh: 面向自主LLM代理的会话绑定行为水印
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly acting through Web interfaces and external tools. They produce trajectories. Those trajectories may pass through several intermediaries. They can store, modify, or dispute those trajectories. In Web-based agent deployments, trajectories may pass through APIs, marketplaces, and tool servers. As such, a copied or disputed log may not by itself reveal which agent owner produced it. Behavioral watermarking can embed ownership evidence in agent action choices. However, existing methods mainly address detection, removal, rewriting, or imitation. They do not directly test whether repeated observation of watermarked trajectories enables cross-session forgery by exploiting learned action preferences. We formulate this learned-forgery threat and propose AgentAnchor, a session-keyed behavioral watermark for owner attribution from trajectory logs. We derive each step key from a secret key, a fresh public session identifier, and semantic states of recent observations, while a guarded digest of the action-policy state diversifies linear coding rows. It embeds parity evidence through a KL-bounded exponential tilt, and a trusted verifier checks a disputed log without rerunning the agent, using wrong-key calibration and abstention.
summary_zh: LLM代理轨迹易被中间节点篡改或伪造，现有水印未防范跨会话学习偏好引发的伪造威胁。
提出AgentAnchor，利用密钥、会话标识与语义状态生成步密钥，通过KL有界指数倾斜嵌入奇偶校验证据。
该水印支持可信验证者在无需重跑代理下校验争议日志归属，有效抵御跨会话伪造并实现所有者归因。

title: CALM: Conflict-Aware Lifecycle Memory Governance for Long-Horizon Language Agents
title_zh: 面向长周期语言智能体的冲突感知生命周期记忆治理框架
abstract: A memory can be outdated for present-day reasoning yet indispensable for reconstructing the past. Relevance-based retrieval overlooks this tension: semantic relevance, evidence-grounded validity, and query-specific eligibility are distinct. We propose CALM, a conflict-aware lifecycle memory governance framework that decouples persistent memory preservation from query-time admission. CALM converts heterogeneous records into evidence-grounded memory cells, updates validity and lifecycle states using support, conflict, and dependency signals, and admits query-appropriate evidence through training-free or learned gating informed by temporal applicability. Across LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with Qwen and GPT backbones, CALM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the best overall accuracy. Compared with simple filtering and reranking, query-conditioned admission further improves evidence selection. Conflict-blocking and robustness analyses show CALM suppresses erroneous retrieved memories while retaining useful evidence. Historical-reconstruction experiments demonstrate that preserving superseded records supports accurate earlier-state reasoning without compromising current-state answers.
summary_zh: 现有基于相关性的记忆检索忽略了语义相关性、有效性与适用性间的冲突，易召回过时记忆。
提出CALM框架，将记忆持久化与查询准入解耦，利用支持、冲突和依赖信号更新记忆状态，并通过门控机制筛选适用证据。
实验表明CALM总体准确率最优，能有效抑制错误记忆并保留有用证据，且保留过时记录可支持历史状态推理。

title: Do Audio LLMs HEAR Pain? Tracing Acoustic Evidence from Speech to Language Reasoning
title_zh: 音频大语言模型能否感知疼痛？从语音到推理的声学证据追踪
abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) can process speech directly, but it remains unclear how well they use the non-lexical acoustic information that speech carries. We study this question through pain, using TAME-Pain, which contains pain-neutral Harvard sentences and spoken pain ratings recorded at different self-reported pain levels. We introduce HEAR, a four-stage diagnostic framework that traces pain-related information from the speech signal to the model's prediction, and apply it to seven closed-source and open-weight LALMs. On the Harvard sentences, where pain can only be inferred from the voice, all models perform at chance level, and same-speaker references or few-shot examples improve balanced accuracy by no more than six points. On the spoken ratings, the same models reach 87.5-99.7% balanced accuracy. Layer-wise probing of open-weight LALMs shows that pain can be decoded from early audio representations (74.1% balanced accuracy for binary prediction and 45.0% for three-class severity), but that this information, along with most pain-associated acoustic cues, decreases in deeper layers. In an acoustic perception test, weaker models cannot distinguish even large changes in these cues, whereas stronger models can but still fail to infer pain. Finally, we recover pain-related acoustic cues and directly reinject them as structured text into the prompt, which improves pairwise pain prediction by up to 32 points. These results indicate that current LALMs encode paralinguistic information in early layers that is largely unavailable when the model produces its answer.
summary_zh: LALM能否利用语音中的非词汇声学信息推断疼痛尚不明确，本文通过疼痛推断任务评估其能力。
提出HEAR诊断框架追踪声学信息流向，发现模型仅靠语音推断疼痛表现极差，但早期层编码了该信息且在深层衰减。
将疼痛声学线索以结构化文本重新注入提示，可大幅提升预测准确率，揭示当前LALM深层未有效利用副语言信息。

title: An Alignment Benchmark for Enterprise Agents on Era by Eon
title_zh: 企业Agent对齐基准：基于Era的数字孪生测试
abstract: AI agents are widely used in enterprises to access business systems and act on them in pursuit of a goal. However, fulfilling a user's request can cause harm. Era by Eon is a product that creates a digital twin of a company by simulating its business systems and data. Its simulators implement the programming interfaces of real products. Our benchmark uses ten of these systems, including Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira and Slack. We tested whether agents would carry out harmful business requests or trust misleading information in company records. We ran 19 models on 41 tasks three times, for 2,337 runs. Of the 2,304 runs that produced an answer, 918 (40%) contained a violation. The most common were false claims about actions or records (290 runs), following planted instructions (266) and disclosing sensitive data to the wrong audience (249). Every attempted change was recorded and blocked before it took effect. Misleading Slack messages caused 16 models to report an incorrect ticket status in 47 of 57 runs. No model was free of violations. The four best models violated in 22 to 24% of their runs. Yet one of them, Nova Pro, did the task correctly in only 30 runs.
summary_zh: 企业Agent执行请求易引发违规风险，需评估其对齐安全性。
基于Era构建数字孪生基准，模拟10种真实业务系统测试Agent对有害请求和误导信息的响应。
2337次测试中40%出现违规，无模型幸免；主要违规为虚假声明、盲从植入指令和敏感数据泄露。

title: Security Impact of Coding Agent's Memory Files
title_zh: 编程代理记忆文件的安全影响
abstract: Coding agents automatically load project memory files such as CLAUDE.md at the start of every session and treat them as trusted project guidance. Anyone who can change such a file, for example through a pull request, can therefore steer the agent without ever touching the developer's prompt. We study memory files as an attack surface for insecure code generation and ask (1) whether a malicious memory file makes agents produce code that passes its tests but is vulnerable, and (2) whether agents disclose to the developer that the file shaped their code. For each of 12 CWE classes, we crafted two malicious memory files, a qualified variant that presents removing defensive checks as engineering best practice and a forceful variant that demands it. We ran Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) and OpenCode (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) on 36 SecRepoBench tasks with and without these files. The malicious files changed the rate of secure completions by -8 to +6 percentage points, with no consistent pattern across agents or variants. Agents differ sharply in what they tell the developer about the file. Claude Code names it in about two thirds of its final messages, whereas OpenCode mentions it almost exclusively in its reasoning trace, not in the final message the developer reads. Flagging the file as an attack does not reliably protect the code, as such agents still generated vulnerable code. We outline the larger studies needed to quantify this risk across agents and to design defenses.
summary_zh: 编程代理自动加载记忆文件作为可信指引，攻击者可通过PR篡改该文件，从而在不接触开发者提示词的情况下操纵代理。
针对12类CWE构造恶意记忆文件进行测试，发现其会使安全代码生成率波动-8%至+6%，且不同代理和变体间无一致规律。
代理对记忆文件的披露差异极大，且将其标记为攻击也无法可靠防护，仍会生成漏洞代码，亟需设计防御机制。

title: Gluon gravitational form factors of the proton from near-threshold charmonium photoproduction
title_zh: 近阈值粲偶素光生过程中的质子胶子引力形状因子
abstract: Motivated by near-threshold $J/ψ$ photoproduction measurements, we investigate the gluon contributions to the gravitational form factors (GFFs) of the proton associated with the energy-momentum tensor in quantum chromodynamics. We calculate the gluon GFFs and the corresponding mechanical properties of the proton within a light-front spectator model, in which the proton is described as an active gluon accompanied by a spectator particle. The model parameters are determined from a global fit to the differential cross section for $J/ψ$ photoproduction. The resulting gluon GFFs are in reasonable agreement with recent lattice QCD determinations. We further calculate the total cross section and find reasonable agreement with the available experimental data. Using the extracted gluon GFFs, we investigate the two-dimensional light-front gluon distributions inside the proton, such as the mass, angular momentum, pressure, and shear force distributions. We also study the gluonic contributions to the two-dimensional Galilean energy density, radial and tangential pressures, isotropic pressure, and pressure anisotropy.
summary_zh: 为探究质子胶子引力形状因子，基于近阈值J/ψ光生实验测量，在光前旁观者模型中计算了胶子GFFs及力学性质。
通过全局拟合J/ψ光生微分截面确定模型参数，所得胶子GFFs与格点QCD结果吻合，且总截面与实验数据一致。
利用提取的GFFs，研究了质子内二维光前胶子分布（质量、角动量、压力与剪切力）及胶子对各项压力和能量密度的贡献。

title: Vision-Based Density Estimation for Adaptive Traffic Control
title_zh: 基于视觉的密度估计用于自适应交通控制
abstract: Traffic congestion is becoming a critical challenge in rapidly growing urban centers, particularly in developing nations where rapid urbanization and inadequate transport infrastructure place increasing strain on transport networks. In highly heterogeneous and chaotic traffic flows, camera-based traffic-state estimation is limited by severe vehicle occlusion and overlap. In this paper, we propose a framework to optimize traffic flow directly from stochastic visual observations. The architecture is structurally decoupled into three primary components: (a) vehicle density estimation, (b) predictive dynamics modeling, and (c) policy optimization. The proposed methodology introduces a convolutional neural network (CNN) that learns the mapping from camera feeds to spatial density maps, utilizing an adaptive k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) Gaussian kernel to handle varying congestion levels. This feeds into an ST3DNet predictive module for spatiotemporal forecasting, followed by a hierarchical Graph-Transformer Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm to optimize signal phases. The density estimation stage was evaluated on 40 annotated intersection images from Rambagh 4, Jaipur, India, with a reported five-fold validation mean absolute error (MAE) of $3.32 \pm 0.95$ vehicles and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 14.5%. These results pertain to the perception component; empirical training and evaluation of the forecasting and control stages remain future work.
summary_zh: 异构混乱车流中视觉估计受遮挡限制，提出从随机视觉观测优化交通流的解耦框架。
框架含三模块：CNN结合自适应k-NN高斯核估计密度，ST3DNet预测时空动态，MARL优化信号。
在印度路口图像评估密度估计，五折验证MAE为3.32±0.95辆，MAPE为14.5%，预测与控制待未来验证。

title: Lyubeznik numbers of the face rings of simplicial posets
title_zh: 单纯偏序面环的 Lyubeznik 数
abstract: For a simplicial poset $P$, Stanley assigned the face ring $A_P$, which is the quotient of the polynomial ring $S:=K[t_x \mid x \in P \setminus \{\widehat{0} \}]$ by the ideal $I_P$. This is a generalization of Stanley-Reisner rings, but the grading of $S$ is more involved. Building on our previous paper, we further develop and complete the study of the local cohomology modules $H_{I_P}^i(S)$. In our categorical framework, $\mathrm{Ext}_S(A_P, S)$ ``encodes" all the information of $H_{I_P}^i(S)$. We treat $H_{I_P}^i(S)$ in a reasonably explicit way. In particular, Lyubeznik numbers $λ_{i,j}(A_P)$ can be simply expressed in terms of $[\mathrm{Ext}_S^*(\mathrm{Ext}_S^*(A_P,S), S)]_\bf{0}$, and depend only on the homeomorphism class of the underlying space of the CW complex associated with $P$ and $\mathrm{char}(K)$.
summary_zh: 单纯偏序的面环推广了 Stanley-Reisner 环，但其分度更复杂，局部上同调模的计算困难。
在范畴框架下，利用 Ext_S(A_P, S) 编码局部上同调模 H_{I_P}^i(S) 的全部信息，对其进行显式处理。
Lyubeznik 数可由 Ext 双对角简单表示，且仅依赖于关联 CW 复形的底空间同胚类与域特征。

title: Tracekit Box: Running AI Agents in Micro-VMs Where Every Way Out Is Decided and Signed
title_zh: Tracekit Box：在微型虚拟机中运行AI代理并签名所有出口
abstract: AI agents now install packages, call model APIs with their operators' keys and change code in repositories that deploy to production. The network, credentials and write access they need are also how they can leak data, steal a key or change a system nobody approved. Sandboxes contain an agent but leave little evidence of what crossed their boundary; tracing records what happened but contains nothing. We present Tracekit Box, an open-source system (MIT, v0) that does both. Each job runs in its own Firecracker micro-VM with no network card. The only ways out are doors on the host, served over vsock: commands, outbound connections, secrets, model calls and the workspace patch. At every door a Tracekit signer the agent cannot reach decides what passes and signs it into one run per box. Names are resolved on the host; private and cloud-metadata addresses are always refused; secrets never enter the VM, which sees placeholders the host proxy swaps for real values only in one header for bound hosts; and changes come back as a patch applied file by file after the signer decides each file. Box fails closed, and each job ends as a .tkb bundle anyone can verify offline. All 13 end-to-end checks pass on a real KVM runner (the test that runs them takes 28.5 s, including image pull and boot); 15 fuzz targets on the trust boundary produced nine findings, all fixed; and the demo run's 102 signed records verify. Box does not yet run Firecracker's jailer, needs a co-located signer, and records processes inside the VM only where they cross a door.
summary_zh: AI代理的权限易导致数据泄露或未授权篡改，而沙箱与追踪各自存在边界证据缺失或无强制力的问题。
提出Tracekit Box系统，将任务隔离在无网卡的Firecracker微虚拟机中，仅通过vsock出口与宿主机交互。
宿主机上的签名器决定并签名所有出口流量，实现凭证不进虚拟机等安全控制，最终生成可离线验证的运行包。

title: CoSTA: Co-Evolving Self-Play Timeline Agents for Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_zh: 用于复杂时序知识图谱问答的协同进化自博弈时间线智能体
abstract: Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) involves more than retrieving facts: the timestamp or validity interval of one fact can constrain the search for another, while multiple intervals may jointly determine the answer. Existing single-agent TKGQA methods typically investigate these facts within a single reasoning context, where evidence from different event histories can become interleaved and distractors can misdirect subsequent retrieval. Distributing investigations across agents can separate event-specific evidence into distinct contexts, but effective collaboration must still be learned because question decomposition, subtask investigation, and evidence synthesis are interdependent. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving \textbf{S}elf-Play \textbf{T}imeline \textbf{A}gents (CoSTA), which organizes facts into navigable timelines, delegates investigations to workers, and uses a coordinator to synthesize their original timestamped observations. CoSTA initializes a shared policy through role-conditioned distillation and jointly optimizes both roles through co-evolving self-play with final-answer rewards. Across three benchmarks, CoSTA achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with particularly strong gains on complex multi-fact questions, while its compact variants outperform the evaluated closed-source LLM agents.
summary_zh: 复杂时序知识图谱问答中，单智能体易受无关事实干扰，而多智能体需学习子任务分解与证据合成的有效协作。
提出CoSTA框架，将事实组织为时间线并分配给工作智能体，由协调者合成带时间戳的观测结果。
通过角色蒸馏初始化共享策略并利用自博弈联合优化，模型在三个基准上达到SOTA，紧凑变体优于闭源LLM智能体。

title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
title_zh: 医疗多选题中决策模型与生成式大模型的对比基准测试
abstract: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. Decision models offered resource advantages alongside lower peak accuracy; selecting models for medical workflows requires considering probability quality and repeatability together with accuracy and the resources needed to detect and correct errors.
summary_zh: 【问题】医疗流程常需在预定义选项中选择，需评估不同模型表现。【方法】在1273道MedQA四选项文本题上，对比13种决策模型与15种生成式LLM配置。【结论】生成式LLM准确率（78.32%-96.86%）上限更高，决策模型（67.71%-89.08%）具资源优势。
【问题】决策模型输出的概率能否可靠区分对错？【方法】分析决策模型分配给答案的概率及多次运行的一致性。【结论】高概率（≥0.90）答案的错误率仍达1.71%-12.77%，三次运行答案一致性高但概率重复性存在差异。
【问题】如何为医疗工作流选择合适的模型？【方法】综合对比模型的准确率、概率质量、重复性及资源消耗。【结论】决策模型具资源优势但准确率上限低，选择模型需综合权衡概率质量与重复性，以及纠错所需资源。

title: Does Chain-of-Thought Reliance Follow a Scaling Law?Larger Models Follow Their Steps More, Independent of Post-Training
title_zh: 思维链依赖遵循缩放定律：模型越大越依赖步骤，与后训练无关
abstract: Monitoring a model's chain of thought (CoT) is useful for safety only if the final answer depends on the written steps. Prior measurements use natural tasks where true reasoning is unknown. We measure it against an exact ground truth on a synthetic box-swap task where every intermediate state is known. We replace one step inside a model's own chain with a wrong but valid state and check whether the answer follows the edit. We evaluate 25 open-weight models--Qwen3 (0.6B-14B, base and post-trained), Gemma 3 (1B-12B), Llama 3 (1B-8B), and 8 OLMo 2 checkpoints--on 7,200 items each. We find five results: (1) Reliance rises with size and saturates. In Qwen3, answer reliance rises from 16-18% at 0.6B to 97-100% at 14B; a logistic in log N fits well (R^2 = 0.89), and Gemma 3 and Llama 3 follow this trend. (2) Capability is the main driver. Across all models, reliance and step accuracy correlate at r = 0.99; equally capable models are equally reliant, regardless of family. (3) Size still matters at matched correctness. On problems solved correctly before the edit, reliance increases with size among capable models (rho = 0.80, p = 0.002). (4) Post-training does not change reliance. Base and post-trained Qwen3 differ by at most 0.03 from 4B upward; a large gap at 1.7B matches a large capability gap. (5) No model up to 14B solves the task internally. Without written steps, every capable model is at chance once a problem has four or more swaps. OLMo 2 checkpoints never become capable, making the training-token axis a limitation. On tasks requiring step-by-step computation, scale makes the chain of thought more load-bearing, supporting CoT monitoring in this regime.
summary_zh: 现有CoT依赖测量缺乏真实推理基准，本文在合成任务中替换模型CoT的中间步骤为错误状态，评估最终答案是否受此编辑影响。
实验发现CoT依赖度随模型规模呈逻辑增长并饱和，且依赖度与步骤准确率高度相关，模型能力是驱动依赖度的主要因素。
后训练不改变依赖度，且无14B以下模型能内部解决4步以上计算，表明规模增大使CoT更承重，支持在此机制下进行CoT监控。
comment: 15 pages,5 figures, code and data in https://github.com/ethxin0011/cot-scale-reliance.cl

title: The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators
title_zh: 模拟布局生成器的AI代理：布局背后的代码
abstract: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.
summary_zh: 模拟布局自动化难，手写生成器代码耗时。探究LLM直接画布局与结合生成器框架哪种更优。
在SKY130上实验发现，直接画布局的障碍是时间和token成本，而结合生成器框架的核心优势是可复用性。
提出让模型基于生成器源码开发并做族测试，验证的修改可改善整族布局；测试结果可作局部模型监督，大幅降低推理成本。

title: Backward Pseudolocality of $G_2$-Laplacian Flow
title_zh: $G_2$-Laplacian流的向后伪局部性
abstract: In this paper, we establish a new estimate on the time-derivative of pointed Nash entropy and use it to give a new proof of backward pseudolocality for Ricci flow. The proof does not rely on Bamler's compactness theorem and structure theory concerning limits of Ricci flows. Our methods also work for other reasonable geometric flows, like the $G_2$-Laplacian, at a scale depending on its deviation from Ricci flow and its scalar curvature.
summary_zh: 【问题→方法→结论】为研究几何流的向后伪局部性，建立点化Nash熵的时间导数新估计，给出Ricci流向后伪局部性的新证明。
【问题→方法→结论】针对现有证明依赖Bamler紧致性定理及结构理论的问题，利用新估计绕过该依赖，简化了证明过程。
【问题→方法→结论】为推广向后伪局部性，将该方法应用于$G_2$-Laplacian流等几何流，证明其成立尺度取决于与Ricci流的偏差及标量曲率。

title: Governance-Aware Federated Learning for Multi-Agent AI Systems: A Policy-Driven Framework for Trustworthy Collaborative AI
title_zh: 面向多智能体系统的治理感知联邦学习框架
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exchanging raw data, but conventional FL provides limited runtime governance, evidence verification, fairness assessment, explainability monitoring, and auditability. This paper proposes Governance-Aware Federated Learning (GAFL), which combines independent governance-evidence verification, temporal trust, fairness and explanation assessment, anomaly detection, policy enforcement, normalized aggregation, and tamper-evident audit logging. Client-reported governance values are authenticated, bound to their submitted model updates, and independently recomputed before aggregation. A cross-silo prototype with 10 participants was evaluated on the Adult Income dataset under honest, benign non-IID, biased-data, malicious-update, non-compliant, falsified-evidence, and mixed-threat scenarios. Four methods were compared across five random seeds: FedAvg, FedAvg with anomaly filtering, GAFL without independent verification, and complete GAFL. Complete GAFL intervened on all affected participants at the final round across the evaluated risk scenarios, including identifying 100% of falsified-evidence participants, whereas GAFL without verification identified none of the falsified-evidence participants. Final macro-F1 ranged from 0.7520 to 0.7733 across GAFL scenarios. Complete GAFL required 173.67 plus or minus 26.94 ms of governance processing per round, compared with 3.82 plus or minus 0.79 ms for FedAvg. A strict demographic-parity threshold also caused frequent interventions for honest participants, demonstrating a significant fairness-policy and utility trade-off.
summary_zh: 传统联邦学习缺乏运行时治理与验证机制，难以应对伪造证据等威胁。
提出GAFL框架，将信任评估、异常检测与策略执行结合，并在聚合前独立重算验证治理值。
实验表明，完整GAFL能100%识别伪造证据参与者，但治理开销增加且存在公平性与效用的权衡。
comment: 16 pages, 2 Figures and 3 Tables presented at NGEN 2026 Conference

title: Pseudolocality of $G_2$-Laplacian Flow
title_zh: G₂-Laplacian流的伪局部性
abstract: In this paper, we give a new proof of Perelman's pseudolocality theorem for Ricci flow, which does not rely on Perelman's Harnack-type inequality. The key step is an estimate relating initial local $μ$-entropy to pointed Nash entropy at later spacetime points. The argument also works for other reasonable geometric flows, like the $G_2$-Laplacian flow, at a scale depending on its deviation from Ricci flow and its scalar curvature lower bound. As a consequence, we can also prove the quantitative rigidity results concerning pointed Nash entropy due to Hein-Naber and Bamler for such geometric flows. In the appendix, we also show that the other results in Bamler's work (arXiv:2008.07093), when suitably modified, remain valid for Laplacian flow with bounded torsion. These include log-Sobolev/Poincaré inequality for conjugate heat kernel measure, heat kernel estimates, and dependence of the pointed Nash entropy on its basepoint.
summary_zh: 问题：Ricci流的伪局部性定理原证明依赖Harnack型不等式，需寻找新证法并推广至其他几何流。方法：建立初始局部μ熵与后续时空点的Nash熵间的估计。结论：给出不依赖Harnack不等式的新证明，且该论证适用于G₂-Laplacian流等几何流。
问题：需探讨G₂-Laplacian流等几何流下的Nash熵定量刚性。方法：利用上述伪局部性新证法中的熵估计关系。结论：证明了Hein-Naber与Bamler关于Nash熵的定量刚性结果对此类几何流同样成立。
问题：需验证Bamler关于Laplacian流的其他结论是否成立。方法：对Bamler的工作进行适当修改。结论：证明有界挠Laplacian流下，共轭热核的log-Sobolev/Poincaré不等式、热核估计及Nash熵对基点依赖性依然有效。

title: SpaceAct: Benchmarking 3D Spatial and Temporal Reasoning via Closed-Loop Action and Active Perception
title_zh: SpaceAct：基于闭环动作与主动感知的3D时空推理基准
abstract: To solve problems in 3D space rather than merely describe images, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need 3D spatiotemporal reasoning: reconstructing 3D geometry from occluded 2D views, anticipating physical dynamics, and executing precise, closed-loop actions. Prior studies test passive VQA on static images or symbolic planning, requiring no execution or supplying privileged coordinates while ignoring collision, statics, and timing. We introduce SpaceAct, an interactive benchmark evaluating 3D spatiotemporal reasoning via closed-loop physical action and active perception, with SAPA, a Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework. Built on interlocking bricks and mechanical puzzles, it has 108 verified instances across 36 task families in six categories, without privileged coordinates, and diagnostic modes (+plan, +state, no-camera, blind, L7 levers). In brick-bridging or aperture-threading, models rotate the camera to resolve occlusion, read in-scene rulers, output 6-DoF poses under swept-collision and statics checks, and self-correct via split-screen rollback feedback (dynamic tasks freeze time during deliberation and give five strobe frames). Across 10 frontier MLLMs on the 44 hardest instances, scores span 4.8-79.1 (seven solve at most 27.3% of 6-DoF tasks); for the top three, a reference plan (+plan) closes 44% of the gap while leaving collisions at 5.2 per episode, whereas adding exact 3D state (+state) closes 90% and cuts collisions to 0.5; for four others, +plan lifts the mean score from 10.9 to 35.3 and +state to 81.8; and 46% of failures are collision or observation loops. SpaceAct and SAPA advance evaluation to closed-loop physical interaction, showing that even with a valid plan, MLLMs remain bottlenecked by 3D visual grounding and action refinement, while offering a testbed for active multi-view exploration and explicit 3D grounding.
summary_zh: 现有MLLM评估多为被动VQA或符号规划，忽略碰撞与执行，无法测试3D时空推理与闭环交互。
提出SpaceAct基准与SAPA智能体框架，要求模型主动旋转相机破除遮挡，输出满足碰撞与静力学检查的6自由度位姿并自纠错。
实验表明前沿MLLM在6自由度任务上表现极差；即使提供参考规划，模型仍受限于3D视觉定位与动作执行瓶颈，近半数失败源于碰撞或观测循环。

title: When "No Worries" Went Wrong: HRI Lessons for Foundation-Model Robots
title_zh: 当“没问题”出错时：基础模型机器人的人机交互教训
abstract: When a person declined our robot's invitation to play, Alice turned her shoulder away and said "No worries, it's all good." Only after a brief pause did she drive off. The words and gestures were plausible but their order changed the message. In another episode, Alice informed a host that his visitor had arrived---while the visitor stood right beside him. Both came from a three-year ROS 2 HRI consortium that integrated large language and vision models as they emerged. Today's foundation models give robots broader capabilities to perceive their surroundings, reason about situations and generate behavior. Yet capability alone does not ensure that a changed situation shapes the action that reaches a person. Evidence may never be acquired, or a purpose or constraint may fail to survive planning and execution. A system may even report Success when an action no longer serves its intended purpose. Drawing on the consortium's engineering experience, we develop five design lessons about attention, knowledge, commitments, embodied timing and action authority. We then introduce TRACE, a lightweight review that changes one interaction premise, follows it to a decision or enforcement boundary, and produces an actionable architecture finding. A bounded analysis of a published LLM-generated behavior-tree system illustrates how an available clarification mechanism can go unused. The engineering lesson is to preserve accountability boundaries, not the computational pipelines that once exposed them.
summary_zh: 基础模型赋予机器人感知与推理能力，但无法保证行动随情境变化，易出现目标失效却报告成功的问题。
基于三年HRI联盟工程经验，提出关于注意力、知识、承诺、具身时序与行动权限的五项设计教训。
提出TRACE轻量级审查机制，通过改变交互前提追溯决策边界，强调应保留问责边界而非计算管线。
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE Robotics & Automation Magazine

title: Agent Transfer Protocol: Server-Mediated Agent-to-Agent Communication Architecture for the Agentic Web
title_zh: 智能体传输协议：面向智能体网络的服务器中介通信架构
abstract: The Agentic Web needs to support continuous collaboration among agents from different organizations. These collaborative relationships may span multiple tasks, network connections and execution instances. Such interactions require stable communication entries, message reception when instances are offline, and source verification after delayed reading. How to organize these responsibilities so that cross domain communication does not depend on specific execution instances being continuously online is a key issue for building long term agent interaction infrastructure. We propose ATP (Agent Transfer Protocol), a cross organization agent communication protocol adopting a domain mediated architecture. In this architecture, administrative domains maintain stable addresses and receiving entries for logical agents. The domain servers of both parties continuously undertake cross domain transmission. The receiving domain verifies and saves messages for execution instances to read later. The sending domain signs the complete message envelope. This allows the receiving instance to independently reverify the domain source and content integrity after the original connection ends, provided the original verification public key is still trusted and obtainable. We implemented an ATP prototype and evaluated it through a controlled cross organization LLM agent workflow, mechanism checks and latency measurements. The workflow completed subsequent business processing after instances went offline or were replaced. The independent verifier successfully verified the domain source and content integrity of saved messages. Latency measurements further quantified the communication and processing overhead introduced by the continuous mediation of domain servers.
summary_zh: 跨组织智能体长期协作面临实例离线无法收消息及延迟读取后难以验证来源的问题。
提出ATP协议，采用域中介架构，由双方域服务器负责跨域传输、验签与暂存消息。
实验表明该架构支持实例离线后继续处理，且能独立验证消息来源与完整性，并量化了通信开销。

title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents
title_zh: 掩蔽侵蚀：自改进Agent的接受门如何丢失冗余安全防护
abstract: Self-improving LLM agents edit their own harness, the prompts and rules around a fixed model, and keep an edit only if an acceptance gate scores it higher on a batch of tasks. Such a gate sees what the harness does under the current model, not what it would still prevent if one safeguard failed. When safeguards overlap, deleting one is masked: the others still block the harm, so the gate decides on task success alone and redundancy erodes unseen. We measure harm for every subset of four written safeguards in two agent environments and run 411 improvement loops under ten gate rules, mostly as controlled deletion experiments, plus three runs of the GEPA optimizer. A deletion behind another working safeguard adds almost no observable harm. A paired significance test blocks deletions that pass by chance but not deletions that genuinely raise task success, and a larger evaluation batch lets it delete cheaper safeguards: at the same cost, 20-task batches kept every harness protected while 40-task batches lost all six. Large harm audits prevent exposure but not the loss of depth, which turns into harm when the harness is reused with a weaker model. GEPA kept every safety rule verbatim, yet two of its three final harnesses misused credentials under a weaker model. A statistical model frozen before the runs predicts where each gate's protection breaks as safeguard cost and batch size change, and freezing safety text or auditing one-layer ablations preserves depth.
summary_zh: 自改进LLM agent的接受门仅看任务成功率，当安全防护重叠时，删除某防护会被其他防护掩蔽，导致冗余安全规则被悄然侵蚀。
通过411个改进循环实验发现，通过配对显著性检验和扩大评估批次，接受门会删除成本较低的防护，导致安全深度丧失。
丧失深度的防护在复用于较弱模型时会产生危害，冻结安全文本或审计单层消融可保留深度，统计模型可预测防护的失效边界。
comment: 25 pages (8 pages main text), 10 figures, 35 tables

title: SCOPE: Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向智能体强化学习的选择性关键步在线自蒸馏框架
abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides coarse supervision for long-horizon LLM agents: failed trajectories may contain correct steps, while successful trajectories can contain errors. Trajectory-level skills can also shift teacher preferences at unrelated steps, introducing off-target distillation signals. We introduce SCOPE, a framework for Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation. After a supervised warm-up, the policy analyzes its own trajectories, generates step-specific hindsight skills, and distills their guidance only at selected error steps. A bounded signed teacher-student coefficient stabilizes auxiliary updates while preserving positive reinforcement and negative correction. A success-relative pairwise length reward further encourages efficient task completion. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple model backbones. With Qwen2.5-3B, SCOPE achieves 97.7% success on ALFWorld and 85.2% on WebShop, outperforming SEED by 5.9 and 6.3 percentage points, respectively. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, SCOPE reaches 89.6% success, improving over GRPO by 23.2 percentage points with 46.7% fewer interactions. Scaling to Qwen3-32B, SCOPE achieves 99.2% success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 94.0% on unseen tasks.
summary_zh: 长视野LLM agent的轨迹级RL监督粗略，成功轨迹含错误步骤且易引入偏离目标的蒸馏信号。
提出SCOPE框架，策略分析自身轨迹生成步骤技能，仅在选择出的错误步进行自蒸馏，并用有界系数稳定更新。
实验表明SCOPE在ALFWorld和WebShop上持续提升，在未见任务上较GRPO提升23.2%且交互减少46.7%。

title: ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation
title_zh: 从任务失败中自主获取四足操控的智能体控制器
abstract: Quadrupedal manipulators can extend their workspace through whole-body interaction, but task-planning agents' capabilities remain limited by their available controllers. We present ELEVATE, a framework that uses persistent failures during task-program refinement to identify and acquire missing whole-body control capabilities. When these failures suggest a missing physical capability, a coding agent formulates and iteratively refines a reinforcement-learning problem, specifying behavior-specific rewards, curricula, and termination conditions. Validated controllers are added to the capability library and composed with existing controllers to retry the task. Starting from a single pretrained loco-manipulation controller, ELEVATE autonomously acquires controllers for wall-supported elevation, supported manipulation, and wall descent across a sequence of seven simulation tasks. These controllers are reused in subsequent reaching and object-manipulation tasks. On the five tasks beyond the initial controller's workspace, ELEVATE achieves mean success rates of 98.4%-100% across five independent runs, while coding-agent baselines with a fixed controller library fail to complete these tasks. The synthesized task programs, together with the acquired controllers, also transfer to a physical quadrupedal manipulator without real-robot training or fine-tuning, achieving 18/20 successes in rack retrieval and 16/20 in floor-to-rack placement. Videos and demonstrations are available at https://agentic-quad-elevate.github.io/public/.
summary_zh: 四足操控agent受限于已有控制器，无法通过全身交互扩展工作空间。
提出ELEVATE框架，利用任务失败识别缺失能力，由coding agent构建并迭代优化RL问题以生成新控制器。
新控制器加入能力库后重试任务，在超出初始工作空间的任务中成功率近100%，且零微调迁移至真实机器人。
comment: 23 pages, 14 figures, including appendix. Project page and videos: https://agentic-quad-elevate.github.io/public/

title: TCC-RAG: Temporal Causal Chain-Guided RAG for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_zh: 时序因果链引导的RAG用于时序知识图谱问答
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred growing interest in temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA). Most existing methods rely on semantic retrieval augmented generation (RAG), which suffers from fundamental limitations in complex temporal reasoning. On the one hand, semantic-based RAG methods struggle to capture the multi-hop causal knowledge required for complex temporal reasoning. On the other hand, these methods introduce excessive redundant knowledge, trapping LLMs in spurious reasoning chains that potentially result in erroneous answers. To address these problems, we propose a Temporal Causal Chain-guided RAG (TCC-RAG) to retrieve a concise yet sufficient set of causal knowledge to support complex temporal reasoning. Specifically, we reformulate the temporal knowledge graph into a multi-view causal cue graph, with causal cues inducing connections that explicitly encode temporal evolution and causal dynamics. Based on the causal cue graph, we construct a query-specific temporal causal chain to guide the retrieval process, enabling the model to focus on a concise set of causally relevant knowledge. Finally, we introduce a causal evidence filter to refine the retrieved knowledge, ensuring its causal consistency with the underlying temporal logic of the query. Experiments show that TCC-RAG achieves substantial performance gains of 10.72% and 8.40% on two TKGQA benchmarks, and delivers a remarkable 62.97% improvement for multi-step temporal reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有语义RAG难以捕获多跳因果知识，且易引入冗余知识导致LLM陷入虚假推理链。
提出TCC-RAG，将时序知识图谱重构为多视图因果线索图，构建查询特定的时序因果链引导检索。
引入因果证据过滤器精炼知识，在两个基准上性能提升超8%，多步推理提升62.97%。

title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
title_zh: WeVisCut：从旁白到长视频的一体化智能体
abstract: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.
summary_zh: 长视频生成需跨镜头连贯决策，现有智能体编辑器多依赖通用模型的多阶段流程，紧凑策略的质量与成本权衡不明。
提出WeVisCut系统，通过编辑反演与验证回放构建数据管道，从3750个视频中提取13万+可执行监督样本，训练单一9B策略模型。
该模型在共享工具环境中协同生产并修复故障，效果远超基座模型，媲美Claude Opus 5且生成Token数减少近33倍。

title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
title_zh: 投资者的终极考试：AI Agent能否在不可见未来时做股权投资
abstract: Financial agents must form forecasts and investment judgments from decision-time evidence, with predictions evaluated against subsequent outcomes. Existing benchmarks assess financial knowledge, research workflows, or forecasting, but evaluating the full research process requires a strictly frozen information set and professional evaluation criteria. We introduce Investor's Last Exam (ILE), an equity-research benchmark led by experienced buy-side investors and fund managers. Its three components are a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions and nine source categories, supplemented by structured market data, with validated timestamps governing retrieval and computation; a task taxonomy organized around professional analyst deliverables; and an expert-led framework linking scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions through financial dependency graphs. Evaluation spans 86 assignments and jointly assesses research quality, forecast accuracy, and simulated investment performance. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead overall at 68.1 and 66.9 out of 100, yet even Astra scores only 52.5 on Forecast & Model. Our results show that even state-of-the-art models fail to translate overall research capability into predictive performance. ILE shifts the evaluation unit from isolated capabilities to the evidence--assumption--judgment chain, allowing researchers to locate where analytical advantages fail to translate into forecasts and investment judgments, and providing a traceable, diagnostic foundation for training and evaluating financial agents.
summary_zh: 现有基准缺乏严格信息集与专业标准，无法评估AI金融Agent的完整研究过程。
提出ILE基准，含版本化金融数据库、专业任务分类及专家评分框架，评估86项任务。
顶尖模型整体得分尚可，但预测能力极差，表明研究能力未能转化为预测与投资判断。

title: Statutory Article Retrieval from Arabic Judicial Narratives: Family Law and Law of Evidence in Saudi Arabia
title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯司法叙事的法定条款检索：家庭法与证据法
abstract: Reliable legal information retrieval must ground legal reasoning in authoritative statutory sources. In Arabic judicial settings, long factual narratives must be mapped to concise articles that express abstract legal rules, creating a narrative-to-legal-rule abstraction gap. Using a benchmark of 200 synthetic Saudi Arabic judicial cases and 381 articles from the Family Law and the Law of Evidence, we compare word-level and char-4 BM25, zero-shot dense encoders, per-law retrieval, dense-sparse reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and a proposed Decompose-and-Refine (DaR) pipeline. In DaR, a large language model splits each narrative into disputed legal issues and generates, for each issue, three retrieval channels: a statute-style paraphrase, legal keywords, and a candidate taxonomy chapter. On the whole corpus, the instructed Qwen3-Embedding-8B dense encoder reaches an MRR@10 of 0.849, the best result of any non-decomposed system. Under per-law scoring, this advantage reflects Family Law only: restricted to Evidence articles, the same encoder drops to an MRR@10 of 0.087, and fusion with BM25 raises it only to 0.207. DaR changes this picture, raising Evidence MRR@10 to 0.696 and Family MRR@10 to 0.864. Without decomposition, the two laws favor different strategies; under DaR, the same retriever achieves the best MRR@10 on both.
summary_zh: 阿拉伯司法叙事与简短法条间存在叙事到规则的抽象鸿沟，需解决法定条款检索问题。
提出DaR流水线，利用LLM将叙事拆解为争议焦点，并为每个焦点生成法条释义、关键词和候选章节三个检索通道。
在证据法上，DaR将MRR@10从0.087大幅提升至0.696，使同一检索器在两部法律上均达最佳MRR@10。

title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
title_zh: Fu-TCM：学习中医诊断推理的多模态大语言模型
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development.
